description: Read the full text of a knowledge-base topic, or a single section of it, with tables and verification tags intact. Use after list_topics or search_glazing_knowledge when you need the complete context (e.g. a whole code table). `topic` accepts a number (30), 'T30', 'Topic 30', or a title phrase ('butt glazed'); `section` accepts a section id like '30.4', 'sources', 'key', or a heading phrase like 'summary table' or 'bid-day checklist'. Long topics are paged: follow the continue_from hint. Responses keep the KB's confidence tags: [V] verified, [V-mfr] manufacturer claim, [UNVERIFIED], [inference], [Expert] field experience.

continue_from.description: Section id to resume paging a long topic from (given in the previous response).

section.description: Section id ('16.6', 'sources', 'key', '32-A') or heading words ('summary table').

tables_as_records.description: Also return section tables as JSON records (header -> value).

topic.description: Topic number 1-32, 'T30', or a title phrase. Optional if `section` is a full id like '16.6'.

name: get_topic

available_sections.description: All section ids in the resolved topic (empty if none).

disclaimer.description: Reference-only disclaimer that applies to every answer.

next_section.description: If more sections remain, pass this as continue_from to page on.

notes.description: Notices: renamed/discontinued products, hints, flags. May be empty.

markdown.description: Section content as markdown (tables intact; may be truncated at max_chars).

tags.description: Confidence tags on this item: V, V-mfr, UNVERIFIED, inference, Expert.

topic.description: The resolved topic, or null if none matched.

title: Read a topic or one section
